pages: Allah is addressing the Prophet Surah Al-Falaq 113 he name of God, the entirely merciful, the especially merciful

tl- Say: “I seek refuge with the Lord of the day break 113:2 - from the evil of whatever He has created 1 13:3 - and from the evil of night's darkness when it spreads around 113:4 - from the evil of the witches who blow on knots 113:5 - and from the evil of the envier when he envies.”
